acceptance_criteria: reinjection and window-bound cases; CHK-12, NEG-18, NEG-19.
statement: The guard **shall** retain a bounded loop-detection window of authorized lineage identities; a request whose causal parent is already present in the window **shall** be rejected (`LoopBound`) with no mutation, and on authorization the request lineage **shall** be recorded and the window **shall** advance under the declared depth bound without unbounded growth.
title: T027 requirement 010
